attchmntText: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited announces that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of up to 4,40,000 stock options under the ESOP 2023 plan on November 10, 2026. The options are granted to eligible employees in compliance with SEBI regulations. The exercise price is up to Rs 468.55 per option. The options may be exercised within up to 3 months from the vesting date. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is also available on the company website.

attchmntText: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited filed the transcript for its Q2 and H1 FY2027 post-earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. The company reported standalone revenue of INR 534 crores, a 78% year-on-year increase from INR 300.49 crores. Consolidated revenue reached INR 544.8 crores, up 83%. Standalone EBITDA grew 60% to INR 51.16 crores, while PAT surged 213% to INR 10.22 crores. Consolidated EBITDA rose 77% to INR 56 crores, and PAT increased to INR 11.74 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansions in EMS, AC, and compressors, with compressor capacity set to double to 60 lakh units by the end of the financial year. The company aims for a consistent CAGR of over 30% in the coming years.

attchmntText: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 07, 2026. The results were published in Active Times and Loknama newspapers. HP Adhesives Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the unaudited financial results for the same period on November 05, 2026. The results are available on the company website. DCB Bank Limited issued an e-auction notice for immovable assets of borrowers Mohammedjabin Abdulghani Shaikh and Najma Mohammdjabin Shaikh. The auction is scheduled for November 25, 2026, with reserve prices of Rs. 76,00,000 and Rs. 35,00,000 respectively. Fakre Alam issued a public notice regarding a lost agreement for sale dated October 12, 2018, for Flat No. 403 in Shivam Palace, Mira Road.
